name: gypsylist
what_it_holds: Python/Selenium scraper (gypsylist.py) for nomadlist.com, pulling city ratings across cost, internet quality, safety, and overall suitability categories via user-supplied nomadlist.com filter URLs. GPL-3.0, 11 stars, 5 forks, 3 commits, no committed output data.

name: apprankings
what_it_holds: Small Python tool (MIT, 42 stars) purpose-built to poll Apple's public top-charts RSS/JSON feeds for a given category/country and log an app's chart position over time to a local store. Last commit Oct 2023 (stale but the endpoint it hits, Apple's public RSS charts, is still live).
why_useful: Directly targets 'rank history' rather than a one-off snapshot -- closest match in this search to a true App Store ranking-history tracker; would need reviving/re-pointing at Travel category + Airbnb's app id, and only starts producing history from whenever it is run.
time_coverage: snapshot-forward from whenever run; unmaintained since 2023
themes: App download and ranking histories: App Store / Google Play rank scrapers, app-store-scraper, google-play-scraper, AppFigures/Sensor Tower/data.ai open samples, app review-count time series

why_all: Directly targets 'rank history' rather than a one-off snapshot -- closest match in this search to a true App Store ranking-history tracker; would need reviving/re-pointing at Travel category + Airbnb's app id, and only starts producing history from whenever it is run.

Matches gap #5 (app download/ranking history as an engagement proxy for Airbnb's app); would need to be run going forward since it captures only present-day rankings, and Apple's own iTunes charts endpoint it hits is a public, non-Airbnb site so within scraping rules.

name: itunes-app-scraper
what_it_holds: Simple Python scraper (MIT, 56 stars) from the Digital Methods Initiative (University of Amsterdam academic group behind 4CAT) for iTunes/App Store search and category-chart data, including app rank within charts and metadata.
why_useful: An academic-group-maintained, citeable alternative to the hobbyist scrapers above for the same iOS rank/metadata pull; DMI tools are often paired with 4CAT for longitudinal capture, so this is the more 'replication package'-flavored option if we want a citable method.

name: gplay-scraper
what_it_holds: Python Google Play scraper (MIT, 308 stars, updated 12 Sep 2026) advertised as extracting 65+ fields per app: install counts, rating distribution, review counts, developer info, ASO metrics, category rank.
why_useful: Wider field coverage than the base google-play-scraper (e.g. rating histogram, not just average) -- useful if the team wants a richer engagement snapshot for Airbnb's Android app and peers in one call.
themes: App download and ranking histories: App Store / Google Play rank scrapers, app-store-scraper, google-play-scraper, AppFigures/Sensor Tower/data.ai open samples, app review-count time series

why_all: Wider field coverage than the base google-play-scraper (e.g. rating histogram, not just average) -- useful if the team wants a richer engagement snapshot for Airbnb's Android app and peers in one call.

Lets the team track Airbnb's Google Play install-count band, rating trend, and review volume alongside peers (Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda) as a general app-engagement demand proxy -- broader than an Airbnb-only pull, and can also profile competitor apps (gap #9) and general travel-app category engagement (gap #5).
